name: AC-1
prompt: A white fibreglass runabout under way on a grey choppy lake, photographed from a second boat some distance away, spray coming off the bow, flat overcast sky, wooded shoreline behind. The boat is far enough away that NO lettering, numbers, markings or text of any kind are visible or legible anywhere on the hull - the hull is plain white. No people visible. Casual smartphone snapshot, not a professional photograph. Flat overcast daylight, no golden hour. Slightly off-level handheld framing, visible sensor noise, natural muted colour, no HDR, no glow. Do not render: human faces, brand logos, ANY text, lettering, numbers or markings anywhere in the frame, golden-hour light, glossy oversaturated colour, HDR halos, studio lighting, watermark.
